correctness.rationale: Starting with one cyclic cooperative block of at least two and at least one defector, payoff P_i=-s_i+[r_(i-1)(s_(i-1)+s_i)+r_i(s_i+s_(i+1))]/2 gives boundary-defector-to-cooperator incentive r_(interior cooperative edge)-1>0 for defector runs of length >=2. The strict interval 1<r_L<r_H<1+r_L/2 guarantees an isolated defector cannot disappear and all rates a_j^+,a_j^-,b_j^+,b_j^- displayed in RESULT.md are positive. States S_j (one defector) and E_j (adjacent pair) make one irreducible 2n-state ring. Kolmogorov cycle-product ratio equals product_j [1+r_(j-1)/2-r_(j+1)]/[1+r_(j+1)/2-r_(j-1)]; on each step-two parity orbit every L-to-H change is balanced by H-to-L, so binary-product exactly one. Detailed-balance recurrence produces stationary probability and mean; homogeneous weights yield 2/r. Verified every binary environment on n=4..10 (2032 patterns) with exact rational factors at r_L=6/5,r_H=7/5. The ternary ring (11/10,11/10,6/5,11/10,13/10) yields exactly 77/75, so reversibility fails. The proof covers all n>=4 and binary arrangements; finite arithmetic checks alone are not the proof. Above-bound extinction is an existence example, not universal extinction.

evidence: General Kolmogorov cycle criterion provides necessary and sufficient product balance, not the nontrivial payoff-specific cancellation for arbitrary binary patterns.
Resultary heterogeneous aspiration study has logistic aspiration revision on two players, not ring boundary under payoff imitation.

value.rationale: Frozen binary environmental heterogeneity is the first natural nonhomogeneous extension of the cycle imitation model. The exact cancellation of every binary label pattern, sharp dynamical trapping, explicit stationary defect number, and 77/75 three-level current distinguish reversible versus circulating stochastic dynamics; these are substantive structural invariants, not a cheap small instance.
